Name: Brume Cloud Foliage
Author: Mushroomed

[center][font=Verdana][/font][/center][center][font=Arial]﻿
[/font][size=5][b][font=Verdana]Br[/font][/b][b][font=Verdana]ume Cloud Foliage[/font][/b][/size][/center][center][font=Arial][size=2]Requires[color=#ea9999][i] [/i][/color][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458][color=#ea9999][b][i]Furniture Framework![/i][/b][/color][/url][/size][/font][/center][size=2][font=Arial]
[/font][font=Arial]

Ever since I first tried [color=#f4cccc][b]GH's Aurora Farm[/b][/color] (the farm shown on the images), it became and remained one of my favorites. It has been always just right for magical or decorating focused playthroughs, for me, a pretty farm map up high above ground, in the clouds. However, I would often think it would be nice to have more of the matching foliage and adornments for it.
So, this small set of nonfunctional furniture objects was made for that purpose, it's meant to be used together!

Colors of the cloud parts on all the pieces change with seasons, matching the farm's cloudy terrain and background starry sky. There are [b][color=#f4cccc]trees,[/color][/b] three sizes with cloudy cover and two bare, one [b][color=#f4cccc]hollow log[/color][/b] half submerged, four sizes of [b][color=#f4cccc]stones[/color][/b] and three sizes of [b][color=#f4cccc]stars,[/color][/b] fallen into the cloud soil. All these items have not been tried with any other farms or terrain recolors, I'm almost sure it would not work well, really they are meant just for this specific farm, as they are. 



[b]Credits:[/b]
All the textures are redrawn and recolored using sprites from the game called [color=#f4cccc][b]Drawn to Life[/b][/color] for DS.
